source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: How models cross each terrain category. Exposed and light features: any model may pass through them both horizontally and vertically. Dense features: **INFANTRY**, **BEASTS**, **SWARM** and **MOBILE** models may pass through horizontally, and **INFANTRY**, **BEASTS** and **SWARM** models vertically; any other model may pass through horizontally only if every section its base would cross is no taller than 2", and otherwise has to climb up or down those sections, without going through ceilings or floors and without ending that move on a surface above ground level. While climbing, a model stays within ½" of the feature horizontally, and the distance it climbs up and down is added to the rest of the distance it has moved during that move. Any model may be placed during set-up, or finish a move, at ground level within a feature; it may do so on a higher surface only if it has at least one of the **INFANTRY**, **BEASTS**, **SWARM**, **FLY** or **MONSTER** keywords and, once there, is stable with its base not hanging past that surface’s outer edge at all. A feature with the Solid rule (see 13.11; dense features have it) forbids ending a move with any part of a model poking through an enclosed part of it 3" or less above the ground, even via doors or windows, so jutting parts of a model cannot get around Solid visibility. Examples: a **MONSTER** facing a dense feature whose sections are all taller than 2" cannot pass through it and goes around it; **INFANTRY** walk through ruin walls; an **INFANTRY** model climbs and ends on a top surface it is stable on; a **VEHICLE** cannot pass through a dense feature but climbs up and down its sections over 2" without ending on top; an **INFANTRY** model crossing a terrain area without passing over or through any feature is not slowed. A **MONSTER** may still climb dense sections taller than 2"; its example only shows that it may not pass through such a feature or finish its move on it.

interpretation.question: May a MONSTER climb dense sections taller than 2 inches?
